name: Infinity
summary:
# Infinity

Infinity is the entire universe in one continuous flight - from your living room to the edge of everything without loading screens.

- Begin close to home. Marvel over our blue jewel just like astronauts do. Visit the quiet Moon then onto our rusty neighbor Mars.

- Then think bigger. Glide beneath Saturn's rings. Watch Jupiter's moons swing into line. Leave the Sun behind until it is one star among billions, cross the Milky Way, and drift in the silence between galaxies and onto the afterglow o
